files.description: Daily weather at one station (90 rows, one per day in date order from 2025-06-01, no gaps): date (YYYY-MM-DD), temp_c (mean temperature in degrees C, two decimals; about 1% empty), humidity (percent, whole number).

task_text: The standard error of the mean of a window is the sample standard deviation of its values (dividing by n - 1) divided by the square root of n, the number of values in the window. Use calendar windows: for each date, the window holds the temperatures of that date and the 6 calendar days before it (empty temperatures skipped). Give the standard error of the mean temperature for every date whose window has at least 3 temperatures, and leave it empty otherwise. `result` should be a Series indexed by date.
intended_computation: Time-based window of 7 calendar days ending on each date (the file has no missing dates); sample sd / sqrt(n) of the n present temperatures when n >= 3, missing otherwise.

acceptable_variants.notes: values to 6 significant digits; The date index may be given as dates, as timestamps at midnight or as YYYY-MM-DD text.

predicted_direction.reason: The time-based rolling().sem() divided by sqrt(n - 1) on 2.x; 3.x divides by sqrt(n) as the task defines.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row X01; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
